" alt="36 houses的s-SR与SPL随任务进度曲线及consolidation配对结果" width="964" height="278" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div><figcaption>PDF Fig. 3，PDF页序9；HTML Fig. 2。36 houses连续部署，只改变run-end consolidation，曲线横轴为归一化任务进度，表格给合并分数与配对CI。 · 点击图像放大</figcaption></figure><p><span class="tag">直接观察</span>实验：Opus 5，每house串联10 tours，tour边界按规定重新放置机器人；两组都保留地图和task记录、相同恢复／核验／预算。结果：No consolidation→Full：s-SR 72.8%→80.5%，+7.7 pp，95% CI [6.3,9.1]；SPL 36.5→44.3，+7.8，CI [6.5,9.2]。CI以house为重采样单位。 <a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#S4.F2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">HTML Fig. 2 / PDF Fig. 3</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A2.SS4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. B.4</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A4.SS4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. D.4</a></p><p><span class="tag">作者表述</span>作者结论：consolidation在持久地图和详细记录之外仍能帮助后来导航。案例5用旧笔记解释dresser措辞；案例10主动查明同一冰箱的两种描述；案例14先被摘要误导，后从失败任务记录找到未查的墙面。但案例14最终468步、SPL 0.08，反而低于无consolidation的156步、0.38，故不能把案例全写成记忆成功故事。 <a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A4.SS2.SSS2.Px1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. D.2 Case 5</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A4.SS2.SSS4.Px1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Case 10</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. D.3 Case 14</a></p><p><span class="tag">概括</span>附录A–C三house中不同任务可能因先前轨迹分岔而具有不同起点。PDF Fig. 13（HTML Fig. 12）另分析双方均成功且起点相差&lt;0.5 m的子集；定性案例的步数差不能全归给某条笔记。模拟“天”也不等于真实全天运行。 <a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A4.SS2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. D.2</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. E</a></p></section><section id="section-08" tabindex="-1"><h2>08 Limitations</h2><h3>作者明确承认的limitation</h3><div class="reader-table"><table><thead><tr><th>限制</th><th>原文支持的边界</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>有限、静态、仿真部署</td><td>没有真实机器人结果，也未测试物体移动、布局变化或人。修订错误记录不能证明能发现真实环境变化；36-house结果也不是长期无限运行证明。<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">App. E scope</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.3</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS6" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.6</a></td></tr><tr><td>控制速度与物理时间</td><td>A–C平均38–45 model turns/task；多次模型推理与工具交互造成明显延迟。GOAT profiling中Opus／Astra为129.5／67.8 s/task，包含setup、navigation与boundary processing，非纯运动时间。<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.1–E.2</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A2.SS3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">B.3</a></td></tr><tr><td>几何与坐标一致性</td><td>当前状态不能表达物体运动、时间变化和可操作物体状态；坐标不重新锚定环境真值；tracker loop closure不会回写已有occupancy cells。认出房间不等于恢复metric pose。<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.4</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A1.SS2" target="_blank" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#S4.SS4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sec. 4.4 末段</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A4.SS2.SSS3.Px2" target="_blank" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A1.SS2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">A.2 File access</a></td></tr><tr><td>小模型能力与监督接口</td><td>Qwen3.5-4B／9B在多轮多模态导航中完成率低，未以其作主要共同backbone；持续监督需要full-duplex和低延迟verifier，现有transport不具备。<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.7</a>；<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS8" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.8</a></td></tr><tr><td>judge与家屋选择</td><td>judge可幻觉并与actor共享模型家族偏差；只验证目标完成，不验证所有空间与程序性记忆。仿真scene ID选archive，真实机器人还需要跨房屋place recognition。<a class="source" href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.34276v1#A5.SS9" target="_blank" rel="noopener">E.9</a></td></tr></tbody></table></div><h3>图表中直接可见的现象</h3><p><span class="tag">直接观察</span>Astra的GOAT
